passage:
Residents near a river joined a community science project. They tested water, counted insects, and reported changes through an app.
Scientists trained them to collect data carefully. At first, some people thought only experts could do science. The project showed that citizens can help when methods are clear.
The data helped identify a pollution problem after heavy rain.
Participants felt more connected to the river because they were not only complaining. They were observing.
Community science does not replace professional research. It expands attention. When many careful eyes watch a place, problems can be noticed sooner.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “Residents near a river joined a community science project.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Community Science Project: Residents near a river joined a community science project.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Public Water Test」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Restored Wetland」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Rain Garden」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
